newsitem.title: UK: Siebe buys electronics unit for 2.1 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Siebe buys electronics unit for 2.1 mln stg.

text.p: Diversified engineering group Siebe Plc said on Thursday it had acquired U.S.- based Ram Electronic Corporation for 2.1 million stg.
Ram makes electronic controls for gas-fired heating, ventilating and air-conditioning(HVAC)appliances such as water heaters, furnaces and boilers.
"Ram's ignition controls complement our range of Robertshaw gas products," said Robert Hill, president of Siebe HVACR in a statement.
Ram will be combined with Siebe's Robertshaw Grayson unit which is a leader in HVAC gas valves, said the company.
